parameters.formDescription: Search on: User ID / Email / Partial email / Email domain

parameters.query:
USE evicore

DECLARE @SearchTerm NVARCHAR(100) = N'{{ $json.UserID }}';  -- ← change this as 

SELECT
    CoreUsers.id            AS CoreID,
    CoreUsers.firstname      AS FirstName,
    CoreUsers.lastname       AS LastName,
    CoreUsers.userid         AS UserID,
    CoreUsers.email          AS EmailAddress,
    CoreDist.name            AS DistrictName,
    ISNULL(URLs.url, '')     AS DistrictURL,
    CASE
        WHEN DM_Prop.role IS NULL                                              THEN ''
        WHEN DM_Prop.role = 'Report Viewer' AND DM_Prop.usersubjectarea IS NOT NULL
                                                                              THEN 'Report Viewer - Teacher (With Options)'
        WHEN DM_Prop.role = 'Report Viewer' AND DM_Prop.usersubjectarea IS NULL
                                                                              THEN 'Report Viewer - Teacher (Own Classes)'
        ELSE DM_Prop.role
    END                                   AS DataMate_Role,   -- DataMate
    ISNULL(ST_Roles.name,  '')            AS StaffTrac_Role,  -- StaffTrac
    ISNULL(AIMS_UserProp.role, '')        AS AIMS_Role,       -- AIMS
    ISNULL(CD_UserProp.role,  '')         AS CD_Role,         -- Curriculum Developer
    ISNULL(F_Roles.name,   '')            AS Forms_Role,      -- EduForm
    ISNULL(SS_UserProp.role, '')          AS SafeSch_Role,    -- SafeSchools
    ISNULL(SV_Roles.name, '')             AS SV_Roles,        -- SurVate
    ISNULL(CoreDist.lastDataSync, '')     AS Last_Sync        -- Last Sync date
FROM evicore..users            CoreUsers
JOIN evicore..districts        CoreDist     ON CoreDist.id      = CoreUsers.districtid          -- Districts
LEFT JOIN evicore..districtUrls URLs        ON URLs.districtId  = CoreUsers.id                  -- District URL
LEFT JOIN evitesting..userproperties        DM_Prop     ON DM_Prop.useridkey   = CoreUsers.id   -- DataMate
LEFT JOIN stafftrac..userproperties         ST_UserProp ON ST_UserProp.useridkey = CoreUsers.id -- StaffTrac (1 of 2)
LEFT JOIN stafftrac..roles                  ST_Roles    ON ST_UserProp.roleid   = ST_Roles.id   -- StaffTrac (2 of 2)
LEFT JOIN aims..userproperties              AIMS_UserProp ON AIMS_UserProp.userIDKey = CoreUsers.id -- AIMS
LEFT JOIN rbemcd..userproperties            CD_UserProp ON CD_UserProp.userIDKey  = CoreUsers.id   -- Curriculum Developer
LEFT JOIN eviforms..userproperties          F_UserProp  ON F_UserProp.useridkey   = CoreUsers.id   -- EduForm (1 of 2)
LEFT JOIN eviforms..roles                   F_Roles     ON F_Roles.id            = F_UserProp.roleid -- EduForm (2 of 2)
LEFT JOIN safeschools..userProperties       SS_UserProp ON SS_UserProp.useridkey = CoreUsers.id   -- SafeSchools
LEFT JOIN eviSurvate..userproperties        SV_UserProp ON SV_UserProp.useridkey = CoreUsers.id   -- SurVate (1 of 2)
LEFT JOIN eviSurvate..roles                 SV_Roles    ON SV_Roles.id           = SV_UserProp.roleid -- SurVate (2 of 2)
WHERE LOWER(CoreUsers.userid) LIKE '%' + LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SearchTerm))) + '%'
      -- optionally extend search to email, etc.:
      -- OR LOWER(CoreUsers.email)  LIKE '%' + LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SearchTerm))) + '%'
ORDER BY
    CoreDist.name,
    TRIM(CoreUsers.lastname),
    TRIM(CoreUsers.firstname);
